9\. A restarted kickoff no longer resets the consult count 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
wants_journal_sentence leaves out kickoffs only through the in-memory Daemon.kickoffs set. When
a hands go job (origin cli) is still held or queued across a daemon restart and the journal is
dirty, the runner rewrites the stored prompt to <sentence>\n\n<kickoff>. consults_used
recognises a kickoff by record.prompt.strip() in kickoffs, so that job no longer resets the
consultation count, and the pipeline can stop early on max_consults.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description A kickoff is recognised only through an in-memory set, so after a restart it gets the journal sentence.
